purpose: Service review for WUP2025 rank 438 Bandar Lampung (city code 5407); local registry evidence and safe anonymous full-polygon access status.
primaryPublisher: Kantor Pertanahan Kota Bandar Lampung (ATR/BPN) and Pemerintah Kota Bandar Lampung
registryBasis: The official city ATR/BPN portal identifies the local land office, and the national public-service listing records a local map (“Peta”) service product. The city’s own JIGN Geoportal is described as exposing GIS web services, but its anonymous homepage request returned HTTP 502. The ATR/BPN root is a JavaScript shell; no anonymous parcel geometry contract was exposed by inspected HTML or static bundles.

officialSources.observation: Official city ATR/BPN portal returned HTTP 200 (6,855 bytes) with a JS application shell. Its two public JavaScript bundles returned HTTP 200; inspected static text contained no map/feature-service schema route.

City JIGN Geoportal description states geospatial data/services can be discovered and GIS web services are provided. Direct anonymous homepage request returned HTTP 502, so no service catalog was available.
